integrity: The proof is analytic for every integer \(n\) at least 2. Exact finite enumeration is used only as an independent consistency check, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines an exact first mixed moment and Mallows linear response, not the full joint law or higher mixed moments. An older equivalent identity under different notation remains a residual literature-search risk.
title: Long-range inversions suppress cycle count in uniform permutations
